_readme: Your campus (eLearn) courses. Re-read on every feed refresh (at most every 10
minutes), so an edit needs no restart — unlike .env.
A course that publishes deadlines: key = the shortname from the feed's CATEGORIES
field, value = the name to show. The leading term number is optional, so
IMT01303305-A resolves the same as 20261_IMT01303305-A and keeps working next
A course Moodle never publishes: Moodle emits an event only for an activity that
has a date, so a course with no dated activity is invisible to the feed and cannot
be discovered from it. List it here anyway, with its name as both key and value.
It then appears in the Accounts card with nothing due — the toggle is simply ready
for the day it does publish. Until then it contributes nothing to Course Deadlines.
